catchOdds.note: TryAwardFromBreak bypasses (does not delete) the odds roll; every break by the last attacker lands on the arm. CarryService.lua:330-337

legacyChanceFor.ref: CarryService.lua:30-31,64-70 (unused, kept for revert; backup ServerStorage.CarryOddsBackup_2026_08_27)

catchOdds.swapRule: while carrying, only STRICTLY rarer replaces: if rarity >= current.Rarity then refuse (CarryService.lua:323-329)
catchOdds.tutorialGate: no carries mid-tutorial unless TutorialCarryPending or already carrying (CarryService.lua:313-318)

rarity.formula: p = (Weight / sum(zoneWeights)) / 2^(tier-1); golden: p *= clamp(GoldenChanceFor(zone), 0.001, 1); mutation: p *= 0.02; lightning: p *= 0.05; diamond: p *= 0.02
rarity.usedFor: swap comparison (lower = rarer) + '1 IN X' showcase display only; NOT an odds roll in 100% catch mode

earnRate.stacking: golden and diamond are exclusive at spawn (elseif); mutation and lightning can each stack on golden/diamond and on each other
earnRate.floor: max(1, floor(rate)) - integer base rate stored as record.Rate

effectiveRate.formula: EffectiveRate(record) = (record.Rate or 1) * 1.18^((record.Level or 1) - 1); FROZEN mutation *= 0.8; returns FLOAT

value.meaning: ~250s (~4min) of the cucumber's earn rate; green number on vault cards AND the SellCarried vendor payout
value.sellCarriedQuirk: SellVendorServer.lua:121-126 pays ValueOf via AddCurrency WITHOUT MultipliersApplied/WasPurchase, so CurrencyHandler.GetMulipliers (CurrencyHandler.lua:66-103) multiplies it by the rebirth mult (1 + 0.5*rebirths, up to 26x) - actual payout exceeds the displayed card value at any rebirth > 0

upgrade.marginalROI: each level: +18% rate for a cost 35% higher than the last - diminishing returns by design
upgrade.notes: cost uses base Rate, never EffectiveRate; upgrades survive take-back/replace/steal/sale via record.Level

accrual.formula: per stored cucumber per tick: Accrued += EffectiveRate(rec) * dt (TICK=0.2s, 5x/s); MOLTEN: rate *= 1 + 1.5 * (HeatT/3600), HeatT += dt capped 3600 (2.5x after 1h uncollected), reset to 0 on Collect

collect.trigger: owner touches the spot's CollectPad (per-cucumber pads)
collect.payout: floor(Accrued) + floor(OfflineCash), sub-1 remainder kept ticking; 1s per-record debounce
collect.multipliers: MultipliersApplied = true -> paid FLAT, no rebirth/coin multipliers (user fix 2026-08-27)

PRISMATIC.note: x20 lives in the base Rate (EarnRateOf), not in vault code

accrual.persistence: write-through SaveVault on every mutation + ~1s cadence in accrual loop; VaultLoaded hard gate prevents overwriting profile with empty stall (VaultService.lua:452-483)

offline.formula: away = clamp(os.time() - Data.VaultLastSave, 0, 57600); if away >= 120: equivSeconds = min(away, 21600)*0.5 + max(0, away-21600)*0.3; per cucumber: OfflineCash += EffectiveRate(rec) * equivSeconds
offline.notes: flat rate (no MOLTEN ramp, no multipliers); uncollected OfflineCash carries over and stacks across absences; paid with next pad Collect; zeroed if the cucumber is stolen (VaultService.lua:1913-1914)

capacity.width: 36 + 5.75 * clamp(level, 0, 5) studs; physical fit floor((width-4.8)/5.9)+1 caps a floor at 10-11 podiums
capacity.stallLevelSource: leaderstats.Rebirths watched live (VaultService.lua:1345-1375); extra slots = PlayerData.Upgrades['Vault slots'] (VaultService.lua:1313-1343)

security.stealGates: not FROZEN; lock lapsed (IsSecured false); thief within 14 studs of spot; empty hands; 1s per-player steal rate limit; not owner
security.stealEconomics: thief gains full record (Rate, Level, Mutation ride along); victim's profile forgets it immediately (SaveVault); Accrued and OfflineCash zeroed - pad money never changes hands
security.heist: victim lands 3 strikes (range 16, cooldown 0.7s) -> auto-return to podium; thief slowed 1.5x (CarryingStolen); thief leaving mid-heist returns it, victim leaving forfeits

timeskip.coinsPerSecond: sum of CarryService.EffectiveRate(record) over the player's stored cucumbers (includes FROZEN 0.8x and level mult; EXCLUDES MOLTEN heat ramp)
timeskip.getRate: CoinsPerSecond * CurrencyHandler.GetMulipliers(Coins) = CoinsPerSecond * rebirthMult where rebirthMult = 1 + 0.5*rebirths (max 26x at 50 rebirths)
timeskip.grant: pays Quote flat (WasPurchase=true); refuses empty vault (quote 0)

questBoard.cadence: 3 quests per 6h cycle, each also grants a cukes time-skip (TimeSkipRateService)

expectedIncome.offlineCoins: sum_i EffRate_i * min( 0.5*min(away,21600) + 0.3*max(0,away-21600), 21600 ) for away in [120, 57600]
